evidence.title: NVIDIA 10-K (FY2026, 2026-01-25)
evidence.excerpt: Our AI technology leadership is reinforced by our large and expanding ecosystem. Our computing platforms are available from virtually every major server maker and CSP, as well as on our own AI supercomputers. There are over 7.5 million developers worldwide using CUDA and our other software tools to help deploy our technology in our target markets.
evidence.locator: 10-K (FY2026) Part I Item 1 Business — Business Strategies, 'Extending our technology and platform leadership in AI' 항목 셋째 문단
evidence.relevance: CUDA 를 쓰는 개발자가 750만 명을 넘는다는 회사 공시로, CUDA 개발자 생태계가 실재함을 보여 준다.

evidence.title: NVIDIA 8-K (2026-09-02) Item 8.01
evidence.excerpt: The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of customary closing conditions, including receipt of required regulatory approvals.
evidence.locator: 8-K (2026-09-02) Item 8.01 Other Events 셋째 문단
evidence.relevance: Hugging Face 인수 종결이 2027 상반기 예정이고 규제 승인 조건부라 기준일 현재 미실현임을 보여 준다.

evidence.title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
evidence.excerpt: More than 18 million developers, researchers and creators use Hugging Face to share more than 3 million models, 500,000 datasets and 1 million applications. More than 200,000 companies use the platform to discover, evaluate, customize and deploy AI.
evidence.locator: 블로그 본문 2번째 문단
evidence.relevance: Hugging Face 의 개발자·모델·데이터셋 규모를 NVIDIA 가 직접 밝힌 문장이다.

evidence.title: NVIDIA 10-Q (2026-07-26)
evidence.excerpt: We refer to customers who purchase products directly from NVIDIA as direct customers, such as AIBs, distributors, ODMs, OEMs, CSPs, AI model makers, and system integrators. Certain direct customers may use either internal resources or third-party system integrators to complete their build. We refer to indirect customers as those who purchase products through our direct customers; indirect customers include CSPs, AI clouds, AI model makers, enterprises, and public sector entities.
evidence.locator: 10-Q (2026-07-26) Part I Item 1 Note 13 Segment Information — Concentration of Revenue 첫 문단
evidence.relevance: NVIDIA 의 직접·간접 고객이 모두 기업·기관이라 제품이 B2B 부품으로 팔림을 보여 준다.

evidence.title: Nvidia's $12.9B Hugging Face deal has an open-source problem
evidence.excerpt: The bigger question is what happens over time. Nvidia could provide earlier support for new models on its own hardware or make deployment easier. At the same time, AMD, Intel, and AWS may have to reconsider how much engineering work they want to contribute to integrations maintained within a competitor-owned platform. Some of that work could eventually move elsewhere.
evidence.locator: 기사 'Deployment defaults favor Nvidia' 절 셋째 문단
evidence.relevance: NVIDIA 소유가 되면 경쟁 칩 회사들이 Hugging Face 기여를 줄이고 떠날 수 있다는 중립성 위험을 다룬 보도다.

evidence.title: NVIDIA Kicks Off the Next Generation of AI With Rubin — Six New Chips, One Incredible AI Supercomputer
evidence.excerpt: The Rubin platform harnesses extreme codesign across hardware and software to deliver up to 10x reduction in inference token cost and 4x reduction in number of GPUs to train MoE models, compared with the NVIDIA Blackwell platform.
evidence.locator: 보도자료 첫머리 요약 첫 항목
evidence.relevance: Vera Rubin 이 Blackwell 대비 토큰당 비용을 최대 10분의 1 로 줄인다는 벤더 주장이다.

evidence.title: Inside the NVIDIA Rubin Platform: Six New Chips, One AI Supercomputer
evidence.excerpt: Feature | Blackwell | Rubin; Transistors (full chip) | 208B | 336B; Compute dies | 2 | 2; NVFP4 inference (PFLOPS) | 10 | 50*; NVFP4 training (PFLOPS) | 10 | 35**
evidence.locator: 기술 블로그 Rubin GPU 절, Table 2. NVIDIA GPU compute capability comparison
evidence.relevance: Rubin GPU 의 트랜지스터 3,360억 개와 NVFP4 추론 성능 50 PFLOPS(Blackwell 10 PFLOPS 의 5배)를 NVIDIA 가 밝힌 표다.

evidence.title: NVIDIA 10-Q (2026-07-26)
evidence.excerpt: Our next-generation Data Center architecture, Vera Rubin, began production shipments in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027. We will be shipping both Blackwell and Rubin systems in the future and are currently experiencing certain supply constraints.
evidence.locator: 10-Q (2026-07-26) Part I Item 2 MD&A — Recent Developments, Future Objectives and Challenges 둘째 문단
evidence.relevance: NVIDIA 가 자기 공시에서 Vera Rubin 의 생산 출하가 2027 회계연도 3분기에 시작됐다고 밝힌 문장이다.

evidence.title: Google and Meta reportedly strike new, multibillion-dollar AI chip deal
evidence.excerpt: Meta Platforms Inc. has reportedly agreed to a multibillion-dollar deal to rent Google Cloud's custom artificial intelligence chips, according to a report in The Information today.
evidence.locator: 기사 1번째 문단
evidence.relevance: Meta 가 Google 의 자체 AI 칩(TPU)을 수십억 달러 규모로 빌려 쓰기로 했다는 보도다.

evidence.title: Google and Meta reportedly strike new, multibillion-dollar AI chip deal
evidence.excerpt: One of the first companies to adopt the new TPUs was Anthropic PBC, which touted the massive price-performance gains they provide, enabling it to serve massive Claude models at scale. Earlier, Google announced it had struck a deal with Anthropic worth “tens of billions of dollars” to give it access to 1 million TPUs through its cloud infrastructure platform.
evidence.locator: 기사 6번째 문단
evidence.relevance: Google 이 Anthropic 에 TPU 100만 개 사용권을 수백억 달러 규모로 제공한다는 보도다.

evidence.title: Custom AI Chips Outpace Nvidia GPU Growth in 2026: ASIC Shipments Set to Triple GPU Rate
evidence.excerpt: Alchip Technologies Chairman and CEO Johnny Shen said Tuesday that he expects revenue growth from custom application-specific integrated circuits to outrun the broader GPU market — a forecast aligned with independent research from TrendForce showing that custom AI chip shipments from cloud providers are on track to grow 44.6% in 2026, against a 16.1% growth rate for merchant GPU shipments.
evidence.locator: 기사 1번째 문단 첫 문장
evidence.relevance: TrendForce 가 2026년 클라우드 업체 커스텀 AI 칩 출하 +44.6%, 머천트 GPU 출하 +16.1% 를 전망했다는 보도다.

evidence.title: NVIDIA GTC 2026: Live Updates on What's Next in AI
evidence.excerpt: In addition, NVIDIA is expanding its open model ecosystem with a new Nemotron Coalition, rallying partners around six frontier model families: NVIDIA Nemotron (language and reasoning), NVIDIA Cosmos (world and vision), NVIDIA Isaac GR00T (general‑purpose robotics), NVIDIA Alpaymayo (autonomous driving), NVIDIA BioNeMo (biology and chemistry) and NVIDIA Earth‑2 (weather and climate).
evidence.locator: 라이브 블로그 'NVIDIA NemoClaw for OpenClaw, Nemotron Coalition' 절 마지막 문단
evidence.relevance: NVIDIA 가 언어·로보틱스·자율주행·생물·기후 등 여러 영역의 자체 모델 계열을 운영함을 보여 준다.

evidence.title: NAVER Cloud joins the NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition: Collaborating toward sovereign AI
evidence.excerpt: Now we’re taking another meaningful step forward: joining the Nemotron Coalition led by NVIDIA. In this post, we’ll look at what the Nemotron Coalition is and what joining it means for us.
evidence.locator: 블로그 도입부 둘째 문단
evidence.relevance: NAVER Cloud 가 Nemotron 연합에 합류했다고 직접 밝힌 문장이다.

evidence.title: NVIDIA Launches Nemotron Coalition of Leading Global AI Labs to Advance Open Frontier Models
evidence.excerpt: The first project stemming from the coalition will be a base model codeveloped by Mistral AI and NVIDIA, bringing together the AI expertise and technology of both companies. Coalition members will contribute data, evaluations and domain expertise to support the model’s post-training and continued development.
evidence.locator: 보도자료 본문 셋째 문단

evidence.title: d-Matrix Adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for Rack-Scale XPU Deployment
evidence.excerpt: Adopters include AWS, which is designing Trainium4 to integrate with NVLink Fusion, and d-Matrix, a custom inference accelerator provider.
evidence.locator: 블로그 'NVLink Fusion — Quick Answers' 절, 'Who are the NVLink Fusion partners?' 답 첫 문장

evidence.title: d-Matrix Adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for Rack-Scale XPU Deployment
evidence.excerpt: d-Matrix also plans to integrate NVIDIA Vera CPUs, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, NVIDIA BlueField-4 DPUs and NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking. Together with NVLink and MGX, these technologies give d-Matrix a proven foundation to deploy specialized inference alongside NVIDIA systems within flexible, unified AI factories.
evidence.locator: 블로그 'NVLink Fusion Integrates d-Matrix XPUs Into AI Factories' 절 둘째 문단
evidence.relevance: NVLink Fusion 을 쓰는 자체 XPU 가 Vera CPU·ConnectX·BlueField·Spectrum-X·MGX 랙과 함께 묶이는 구조를 보여 준다.

evidence.title: Custom AI Chips Outpace Nvidia GPU Growth in 2026: ASIC Shipments Set to Triple GPU Rate
evidence.excerpt: This is precisely why Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta have each committed billions of dollars to in-house AI chip programs. Google's Ironwood TPU, Amazon's Trainium series, Microsoft's Maia 200, and Meta's MTIA accelerators are all custom application-specific chips that reduce their builders' dependence on Nvidia hardware and optimize for the specific model architectures and inference patterns each company runs at scale.
evidence.locator: 기사 'Why Hyperscalers Choose Custom Silicon Over Nvidia GPUs' 절 셋째 문단
evidence.relevance: 하이퍼스케일러 4곳(Google·Amazon·Microsoft·Meta)이 모두 자체 AI 칩을 개발한다는 보도다.

evidence.title: OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic absent from Nvidia-led Open Secure AI Alliance
evidence.excerpt: Founding members include NVIDIA, Dell Technologies, Synopsys, Microsoft, IBM, Red Hat, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Hugging Face, Databricks, SpaceXAI, and The Linux Foundation. Conspicuously absent from the alliance are OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic, companies behind proprietary, "closed" AI models.
evidence.locator: 기사 본문 'According to the announcement' 문단 둘째·셋째 문장
evidence.relevance: NVIDIA 가 주도한 Open Secure AI Alliance 에 OpenAI·Google·Anthropic 이 빠졌다는 보도다.

evidence.title: NVIDIA 10-Q (2026-07-26)
evidence.excerpt: In addition, access to capital can be particularly constrained for less-capitalized companies, which may face difficulties securing financing for large-scale infrastructure projects. We believe AI clouds and AI model makers have significant demand for training and inference compute and currently lack the ability to secure long-term infrastructure contracts and investment-grade financing capacity to secure the AI infrastructure necessary to grow.

evidence.title: NVIDIA Corp. (NVDA) Q2 2027 Earnings Call Corrected Transcript (2026-08-26)
evidence.excerpt: Our AI-native start-up ecosystem, developed and running primarily on the NVIDIA Compute platform, is scaling at a rapid pace. Global VC funding in AI, roughly 70% of which is spent on compute, exceeded $400 billion in the first half of 2026, surpassing the $265 billion raised in all of 2025.

evidence.title: Nvidia embraces role of AI investor, pushing past $40 billion in equity bets this year
evidence.excerpt: In 2026, the pace of deals has kicked into overdrive, with Nvidia already topping $40 billion in commitments and expanding its portfolio to include more public equities. This week alone Nvidia forged an agreement with data center operator IREN, giving it the right to invest up to $2.1 billion in the company, a day after Nvidia struck a pact with Corning, allowing it to invest up to $3.2 billion in the 175-year-old glass maker.
evidence.locator: 기사 본문 2·3번째 문단
evidence.relevance: NVIDIA 의 2026년 지분 투자 약정이 $40B 를 넘었고 IREN $2.1B·Corning $3.2B 가 들어 있다는 보도다.

evidence.title: Nvidia embraces role of AI investor, pushing past $40 billion in equity bets this year
evidence.excerpt: Its single largest bet was a $30 billion check for ChatGPT creator and longtime partner OpenAI. Nvidia also participated in massive funding rounds for Anthropic and Elon Musk's xAI, shortly before it merged with SpaceX in February.
evidence.locator: 기사 ''We don't pick winners'' 절 첫 문단
evidence.relevance: OpenAI $30B 와 Anthropic·xAI 펀딩 라운드 참여를 다룬 보도다.

evidence.title: Nvidia embraces role of AI investor, pushing past $40 billion in equity bets this year

evidence.locator: 기사 본문 Marvell·Lumentum·Coherent 문단(Corning 공장 문단 다음)
evidence.relevance: 공급망 기업 Marvell·Lumentum·Coherent 에 각 $2B 를 넣었다는 보도다.

evidence.title: Nvidia embraces role of AI investor, pushing past $40 billion in equity bets this year

It also invested $2 billion in Nebius Group, an AI cloud company, as part of an agreement on AI infrastructure deployment, fleet management, inference and AI factory design.
evidence.locator: 기사 본문 네오클라우드 문단(Marvell 문단 다음)
evidence.relevance: 네오클라우드 CoreWeave·Nebius 에 각 $2B 를 넣었다는 보도다.

NVIDIA 는 2026년 다섯 달 동안 AI 기업 지분에 $40B 넘게 넣었고(실측), 여기에는 OpenAI $30B, Anthropic Series G(최대 $10B), xAI Series E, CoreWeave $2B, Nebius $2B 와 공급망(Corning $3.2B, Marvell·Lumentum·Coherent 각 $2B, IREN $2.1B)이 들며, 그 돈이 GPU 대금으로 돌아오고 매출이 피투자사 가치를 올려 지분 평가이익까지 늘리는 이중 고리라고 판정했다. [EV-nvidia-042, EV-nvidia-043, EV-nvidia-044, EV-nvidia-045]

NVIDIA 는 돈만이 아니라 신용도 댄다. 일부 금융 거래에서 GPU 잔존가치를 최대 25% 보증하고, SB Energy 보증 상한은 $105B(2026-08-17 8-K, OpenAI 계열사용 오하이오 PORTS 캠퍼스 4.25GW 의 토지·전력·셸)이며, CoreWeave 미판매 캐파 매입 약정(초기 가치 $6.3B, 2032-04-13까지)과 월가와의 $500B AI 인프라 금융 조성이 있다. [EV-nvidia-010, EV-nvidia-046, EV-nvidia-047, EV-nvidia-048, EV-nvidia-049, EV-nvidia-050, EV-nvidia-051]
잔존가치를 보증한 담보(Grace Blackwell)의 가치를 깎는 것이 NVIDIA 자신의 신제품 Vera Rubin 이라는 자기모순도 있다. [EV-nvidia-052]
2026-08-26 2분기 실적 콜에서 나온 생태계 커밋 약 $500B 는 애널리스트가 CFO 코멘터리의 약정·보증을 더한 수치이고, 2026-07-26 현재 약정 가운데 공급·캐파 약정이 $279B, 지분 투자 약정이 $25B 다. [EV-nvidia-053, EV-nvidia-054]
최근 1년(2025-07-28~2026-07-26) 영업외이익 $32.2B(세전이익의 14%)는 ⑥ 소관이라 ⑦ 의 입력이 아니며, 출처가 고객사 지분이라는 점만 방증으로 적는다. [EV-nvidia-055, EV-nvidia-056, EV-nvidia-057]

evidence_after: NVIDIA ⑧ 은 -3점이다.
다만 감점을 덜어 주는 근거는 가점과 같이 실측으로만 인정하므로(rules.md 2.1), 이 헤지는 데이터센터 매출 가운데 비하이퍼스케일러 비중이 실제로 올라와야 점수에 닿는다. Hugging Face 인수도 종결 전이라 이 헤지의 실행으로 세지 않는다.
evidence_up_after: 반대 방향의 힘도 있다. 자체 칩을 만들 자본이 있는 고객은 소수이고 오픈웨이트로 창업하는 다수는 기존 클라우드의 NVIDIA GPU 를 빌려 쓰므로, 오픈소스 확산은 GPU 판매자에게 시장 확대라고 본다(추론). [EV-nvidia-058]
evidence_down_after: 매출 약 절반을 내는 하이퍼스케일 고객이 모두 자체 칩을 개발하고 있어, 고객 집중과 의존 방향이 함께 나빠지고 있다. 미 정부는 중국 우회 접근을 조사하고 있다. [EV-nvidia-024, EV-nvidia-038, EV-nvidia-059]

공급 쪽에는 공급·캐파 약정 $279B(2026-07-26 현재, 주로 메모리·제조 설비)가 있다. NVIDIA 는 TSMC 매출의 19% 를 차지하는 최대 고객이고, 이 공급 약정이 2026-08-26 실적 콜에서 애널리스트가 더한 생태계 커밋 약 $500B 의 가장 큰 부분이다. [EV-nvidia-060, EV-nvidia-061, EV-nvidia-053, EV-nvidia-062]
수요가 꺾이면 이 약정 때문에 NVIDIA 가 먼저 맞으며, 2022년 재고 관련 $1.22B 를 포함한 $1.34B 상각이 그 선례다. [EV-nvidia-063]

evidence_after: NVIDIA ⑨ 는 감점 없이 0점이다.
게이트 1(본업이 버는가)은 통과한다.
게이트 2(현금이 새는가)는 FCF 추세를 안정으로 판정해 0점에서 끝난다.
고객 금융을 받치는 우발 보증은 확정 지출이 아니어서 ⑦ 에서 세고 ⑨ 에는 넣지 않는다.
